requirements: A signed-in user can edit a post if and only if the user's ID equals the post author's ID.
A user with a different ID must not be allowed to edit the post.
A user with no signed-in ID must not be allowed to edit the post.
edge_cases: user ID differs from owner ID
notes: Illustrative function based on the supplied owner-only-edit user story, NOT Summit's verified implementation. Update this spec against actual app contracts.
